[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part VII · Suits Relating to Tort
 Section: 76::One year.
]


For compensation for slander.
Period of limitationOne year.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the words are spoken, or, if the words are not actionable in themselves, when the special damage complained of results.
